messages:
incident-bot: AUTOPAGE fired -> prometheus.scrape_failure rate high for job=legacy-collector across 3 regions. PagerDuty engagement created: PD-INC-8721. @oncall-sre please ack. link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/8721

oncall-sre: acked oncall, looking now. seeing 502s from the collector pods to our exporter endpoint.

maria.sre: I can grab logs. which cluster is flapping?

oncall-sre: eu-west-1 primary, also some errors in us-west-2. exporter deployment `legacy-collector` on namespace `metrics` is showing restart loops.

jordan.platform: adding the collector logs here, looks like TLS handshake failures after the last cert rotation patch.

leo.ops: oof, cert rotation ran ~20m ago for the collector fleet. that might be the cause. but why are we seeing PD duplicate pages? PD shows 3 separate incidents for the same symptom.

pd-bot: PD update: Incident PD-INC-8721 acknowledged by oncall-sre. Duplicate incidents detected: PD-INC-8722 & PD-INC-8723 — merging root cause candidate 'legacy-collector scrape failures'.

maria.sre: logs (filtered):
```
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z legacy-collector[3245]: handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate
2026-03-15T14:02:13Z legacy-collector[3245]: connection reset by peer
2026-03-15T14:02:14Z prometheus-scraper[1122]: 502 from legacy-collector: upstream cert mismatch
```

oncall-sre: thanks. quick mitigation plan: 1) scale up fallback exporter replicaset (backup-collector), 2) roll collector cert back to previous version, 3) temporary scrape bypass to backup job. Suggest we run 1 and 3 asap to reduce missing metrics window.

jordan.platform: I can scale the backup-collector to 4 replicas now. `kubectl scale deployment backup-collector -n metrics --replicas=4`

leo.ops: doing the rollback of the cert controller for the collector fleet to previous revision, patch-id `cert-2026-03-14-7b`. Applying now.

incident-bot: NOTE: autopage suppress windows updated: redundant alerts for same fingerprint suppressed for 10m.

oncall-sre: scaling done by jordan, backup-collector ready and passing readiness checks. Prometheus scrape targets for job `legacy-collector` show healthy for the backup targets.

maria.sre: cert-rollback applied, restarting pods gracefully. logs show TLS handshakes succeeding now.

maria.sre: logs: 
```
2026-03-15T14:09:33Z legacy-collector[3278]: handshake completed, peer CN=prometheus-scraper
2026-03-15T14:09:35Z prometheus-scraper[1122]: 200 OK from legacy-collector
```

oncall-sre: prometheus scrape failure rate dropping to normal. dashboards updating.

leo.ops: checking PD, duplicates PD-INC-8722/8723 auto-merged into PD-INC-8721. notifications suppressed.

pd-bot: PD-INC-8721 status changed to RESOLVED by oncall-sre (mitigation: rollback cert + scale backup).

oncall-sre: marking incident as resolved in slack, but we still need RCA and customer impact check. Early data shows a 6-8 minute window where `org_metrics` series for 3 customers had missing points.

maria.sre: query: `absent_over_time(org_metrics{org=~"cust-123|cust-987|cust-456"}[10m])` returned true for those orgs between 14:03-14:11 UTC.

jordan.platform: confirm: ingestion lag for logs was not changed; only metric scrape was affected. No alerts from support yet.

oncall-sre: customer impact: degraded dashboards for 3 customers, no SLO breach projected (we're within alerting thresholds), but need follow-up email for transparency.

leo.ops: creating a post-incident task: 1) add canary cert rotation to staging, 2) fix autopage fingerprinting to reduce duplicate PD spawns, 3) test backup-collector automatic promotion in failover. Assign to maria.sre & jordan.platform.

maria.sre: will take cert rotation canary + logs for 7d.
jordan.platform: I'll own backup promotion logic and PD fingerprint tuning.

oncall-sre: thanks team. closing the thread, leaving PD ticket and follow-ups in the incident board: https://boards.redwood.internal/incidents/8721.

incident-bot: Addendum: If you saw duplicate pages, that's due to the scrape job firing across regions before the fingerprint dedupe window expired. We're adjusting fingerprinting and will post a config change PR. :white_check_mark:
